snap.toggle.title: Snap to the drawing's own lines while measuring: ends, midpoints, crossings, or anywhere on a line (F3)
snap.on: Snapping to the drawing's lines (F3 turns it off).
snap.off: Snapping off: points go exactly where you click (F3 turns it back on).
snap.truncated: This sheet has more lines than snapping reads: it uses the first {n} segments.
snap.none: This sheet has no lines to snap to (a scanned page is a picture). Points go where you click.
settings.snap: Snap to the drawing's own lines
settings.snap.hint: While you measure or calibrate, a point near a line of the PDF jumps to its end, its midpoint, a crossing, or the nearest point on it, and a marker shows which. F3 or Snap in the status bar turns it on and off. Scanned sheets have no lines to snap to.
toolbar.export.title: Export the estimate (XLSX, CSV) or a marked copy of the PDFs
toolbar.deduct.title: Deduct mode for linear runs: the next segments are drawn but not counted, like a door in a wall (E)
deduct.on: Deduct on: the next segments of a run are drawn but not counted, like a door in a wall. E turns it off.
deduct.all: A run needs at least one segment that counts. Leave one segment counted, or delete the run.
typein.label: Type
typein.hint: Type a length toward the pointer (12'6"), a length at an angle (12'6"<45), @right,up from the last point (@6',-4'), or right,up from the first point (6',4'). Enter places the point; Enter on an empty box finishes; Esc closes the box.
typein.hint.circle: Type the radius (2'6") and press Enter; the circle goes toward the pointer's side.
typein.err.read: That could not be read. Type a length (12'6"), a length and angle (12'6"<45), @right,up from the last point, or right,up from the first point.
typein.err.first: Click the first point, then type the next ones.
typein.err.dir: Move the pointer the way the segment goes, then type its length.
typein.err.zero: That point is where the last one is. Type a move that is not zero.
typein.err.noscale: This sheet has no scale, so typed lengths have no size. Give it a scale first.
export.areas.all.note: Formulas run per area, so rounding up (ceil) per area can make this a little more than the job total on Estimate.
area.label: Bid area
area.cur.title: The bid area (building, floor or phase) new marks go in; marks in other bid areas are dimmed on the sheet
area.new.title: New bid area

area.name: Name
area.name.empty: Type a name for the bid area.
area.manage.title: Bid areas

area.manage.none: No bid areas yet. Add one below.
area.delete.title: Delete "{area}"?

area.delete.text.other: Its {n} marks stay, in no bid area. You can undo this.

area.cur: New marks go in {area}. Marks in other bid areas are dimmed.
area.cur.none: New marks go in no bid area.
qty.area.empty: No marks in a bid area yet.
viewcube.hint: Arrow keys choose a side, edge or corner; Enter looks from there. Shift with Left or Right turns the view a quarter turn. Home goes to the home view.
viewcube.step.left: Look from the side on the left
viewcube.step.right: Look from the side on the right
viewcube.step.ccw: Turn the view a quarter turn counter-clockwise
viewcube.step.cw: Turn the view a quarter turn clockwise
viewcube.home.title: Home view: fit everything, looking from the front, right and above
viewcube.axes: Axes: X red, Y green, Z blue
cmp.button.title: Compare this sheet with an older version of it, and move the takeoff over
cmp.pick.title: Compare with an older sheet
cmp.pick.text: The sheet on screen ({sheet}) is the revision. Pick the older sheet it replaces: it shows in red on top, and its takeoff can move here.
cmp.pick.label: Older sheet
cmp.pick.none: Open the older PDF too: comparing needs two sheets.
cmp.summary: Comparing with {old}: the old drawing is red, this one black; where they agree they overlap.
cmp.summary.changes: {f} of the {n} marks on the old sheet sit where the drawing changed.
cmp.align.step1: Align 1 of 4: click a point on the OLD drawing (red), like a column or a wall corner.
cmp.align.step2: Align 2 of 4: click the same point on the NEW drawing (black).
cmp.align.step3: Align 3 of 4: click a second point on the OLD drawing (red), far from the first.
cmp.align.step4: Align 4 of 4: click that point on the NEW drawing (black).
cmp.align.done: Aligned: the old drawing moved onto the new one (size × {scale}).
cmp.align.bad: Those points are on one spot, so they cannot line the drawings up. Try two points far apart.
cmp.found: Changes: {removed} pixels of ink only on the old sheet (red), {added} only on the new (blue).
cmp.same: The two drawings match: no changes found.
cmp.nomarks: The old sheet has no marks to move.
cmp.scale.title: The scales differ
cmp.scale.text: On this sheet the old takeoff's scale works out to {old}, but this sheet is set to {new}. Moved marks will be measured at {new}.
cmp.same_sheet: Pick another sheet: that is the one on screen.
flag.next.title: Show the next mark flagged for review (the drawing changed under it)
flag.note: The drawing changed under this mark in the revision. Check it against the new drawing, then choose Checked.

cmp.flagged.=0: None sits where the drawing changed.
cmp.flagged.one: 1 is flagged (orange): the drawing changed under it, so check it.
cmp.flagged.other: {n} are flagged (orange): the drawing changed under them, so check each one.

cmp.flagged.found.=0: No mark sits where the drawing changed.

file.saved: Saved {file}. It reopens on top of the same PDFs (they are matched by their contents).
file.save_failed: The takeoff could not be saved: {error}
item.backout: Back-out: its marks take their area out of other items
item.backout.none: Make the area items it takes area out of (flooring, ceiling…) first.

item.backout.bad.one: 1 mark of this back-out is not convex, so it takes nothing out. Redraw it without inward corners, or as two marks.
item.backout.bad.other: {n} marks of this back-out are not convex, so they take nothing out. Redraw them without inward corners, or as several marks.

backout.convex: A back-out has to be convex: a rectangle, a circle or any outline without an inward corner. Draw an L-shaped back-out as two marks.
backout.noholes: A back-out cannot have cut-outs. Draw it as convex pieces instead.
backout.mark.convex: This back-out has an inward corner, so it takes nothing out. Redraw it as convex pieces.
